parole.significato: Pearl millet (Cenchrus americanus, syn. Pennisetum glaucum).
parole.testo: From Hindi बाजरा (bājrā). Compare bajri from Gujarati બાજરી (bājrī).

parole.significato: An Indian dish of puffed rice with potatoes and a tangy tamarind sauce.
parole.testo: From Hindi भेलपूरी (bhelpūrī), and its cognates: Gujarati ભેળપૂરી (bheḷpūrī), Marathi भेळ (bheḷ).

parole.significato: A posthouse of the old Indian postal service (dak), used as lodging by itinerant British officials and other travellers…
parole.testo: From Hindi डाक बंगला (ḍāk baṅglā) under influence from Gujarati ડાકબંગલો (ḍākbaṅglo).

parole.significato: A two-wheeled oxcart used for transporting freight.
parole.testo: Uncertain. Variously derived from corruption of hackney (“cheap carriage for hire”), from Hindi चक्र (cakra, “wheel”) under influence from -ery, and from Gujarati ચક્રો (cakro, “ox-cart, rickshaw”), the latter two both from Sanskrit चक्र (cakra, “wheel, disc, cycle”).

parole.significato: the closure of shops and offices, typically as a strike.
parole.testo: Borrowed, via Hindi हड़ताल (haṛtāl), from Gujarati હડતાળ (haḍtāḷ), હડતાલ (haḍtāl), literally “locking of shops”.
